## Accepted OOS — filed

| OOS title | Issue | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Follow-ups for #3628 (combines OOS_2/3/5/6) | #3640 | https://github.com/character-ai/larch/issues/3640 |

- **Filed**: 1

## Rejected / Out-of-Scope Observations (not filed)

Operator decision on #3628: file only OOS_2/3/5/6 (#3640); the rest are non-converging review polish — doc-nits to fix inline or pre-existing/unrelated findings — recorded here as explicit dispositions (no GitHub issue filed).

### OOS_1: Broader validator default repo-root ambiguity — pre-existing validate-plan.sh behavior, not introduced by #3628.
- **OOS_1**: rejected (pre-existing)
### OOS_4: Run-params re-init can overwrite stored router flags — pre-existing run-params merge path.
- **OOS_4**: rejected (pre-existing)
### OOS_7: Structure tests do not pin Step 0-pre KV count — minor harness nit; the parse-argv 8-KV count is pinned in test-parse-design-argv.sh.
- **OOS_7**: rejected (nit)
### OOS_8: PYTHON override vs bare python3 probes split — pre-existing, unrelated to #3628.
- **OOS_8**: rejected (pre-existing/unrelated)
### OOS_9: README omits Python floor — unrelated to the /design auto-apply feature.
- **OOS_9**: rejected (unrelated)
### OOS_10: test-design-structure comment stale — doc nit.
- **OOS_10**: rejected (doc-nit)
### OOS_11: plan-review stale Gate B apply-point line — doc nit; later sections were updated.
- **OOS_11**: rejected (doc-nit)
### OOS_12: validate-plan defaults repo root to plugin tree — pre-existing validate-plan.sh behavior.
- **OOS_12**: rejected (pre-existing)
### OOS_13: Python 3.11 baseline changes unrelated to this PR — confused finding; no Python baseline code change was made (the bash ship path was a runtime choice, not a code edit).
- **OOS_13**: rejected (false/confused)
